set.body:
Outcome

Demonstrate that the two decisive vertical slices share one ontology with no method-specific exception in their axes, frames, plan identity, result shell, or receipts.

Acceptance

- Both vertical-slice gates are closed.
- Shared-shell conformance tests pass.
- Prototype duplicates and escape hatches are deleted.
- Public examples show one Mvpa vocabulary.
set.title: P4: certify one architecture across predictive and relational kernels
